comparison.objective: Ratchet a strap taut, latch its handle and retain a crate through a deck jolt; candidate tunes and locks a damper before impact trials.
comparison.physical_skill: Both combine repeated rotary/oscillatory adjustment, locking and a later dynamic load test. Record requires large ratchet strokes and strap tensioning; candidate requires recessed key insertion, continuous fine collar tuning and settings inferred from stopping response.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires at least 50 N tension, closed handle and limited crate motion during a prescribed jolt. Candidate requires two non-bottoming carriage stops within a damper envelope and low setting drift, though rebound, overload and drift limits are undeclared.
comparison.reason: Despite a similar adjust-lock-test structure, the tested manipulation and physical quantity differ materially: load restraint tension versus damping calibration.
